description: Renovate bumps the hardening role in each images/<name>/image.yml, the Packer plugins, Packer itself in versions.yml, the tools in tools/tools.yml, the Ansible collections, the Python tools and GitHub Actions digests. Each image's pins get their own pull request, which runs that image's build, test and audit gate before it can merge. Installer ISOs are not Renovate's job: see CONTRIBUTING.md. Renovate bumps versions only: the Pins workflow runs `just repin` on its branches to pin what goes with them (archive hashes, Python locks, audit content).
